newsitem.title: USA: Premature to cap CRP enrollment--USDA spokesman.
newsitem.headline: Premature to cap CRP enrollment--USDA spokesman.

text.p: A House Appropriations subcommittee acted prematurely to vote to cap new entries to the Conservation Reserve Program at 14 million acres this year, Agriculture Department spokesman Tom Amontree said Wednesday.
"It's premature to assess the size of the CRP (Conservation Reserve Program) until we finish evaluating the signup, which we expect to have complete by the end of May," Amontree told Reuters.
Farmers have offered 25.6 million acres for the reserve. Contracts on 21 million acres expire this fall. USDA has indicated it might accept up to 19 million acres.
